questions.stem: -30 Choose the correct letter A, B or C. Study on Gender in Physics 21. The students in Akira Miyake’s study were all majoring in

options.text: physics
psychology or physics
science, technology, engineering or mathematics

questions.stem: The aim of Miyake’s study was to investigate

options.text: what kind of women choose to study physics
a way of improving women’s performance in physics
whether fewer women than men study physics at college

questions.stem: The female physics students were wrong to believe that

options.text: the teachers marked them in an unfair way
the male students expected them to do badly
their test results were lower than the male students’

questions.stem: Miyake’s team asked the students to write about

options.text: what they enjoyed about studying physics
the successful experiences of other people
something that was important to them personally

questions.stem: What was the aim of the writing exercise done by the subjects?

options.text: to reduce stress
to strengthen verbal ability
to encourage logical thinking

questions.stem: What surprised the researchers about the study?

options.text: how few students managed to get A grades
the positive impact it had on physics results for women
the difference between male and female performance

questions.stem: Greg and Lisa think Miyake’s results could have been affected by

options.text: the length of the writing task
the number of students who took part
the information the students were given

questions.stem: Greg and Lisa decide that in their own project, they will compare the effects of

options.text: two different writing tasks
a writing task with an oral task
two different oral tasks

questions.stem: The main finding of Smolinsky’s research was that class teamwork activities

options.text: were most effective when done by all-women groups
had no effect on the performance of men or women
improved the results of men more than of women

questions.stem: What will Lisa and Greg do next?

options.text: talk to a professor
observe a science class
look at the science timetable
